jobs.employer_name: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description: A Snapshot of Your Day As a Experienced IT Business Analyst & Project Manager (f/m/d), you drive complex IT transformation and change initiatives across Treasury and Corporate Finance. You act as the key interface between business stakeholders, internal IT teams, architects and external implementation partners, translating business requirements into effective IT solutions while ensuring successful project delivery across integrated enterprise application landscapes.How You’ll Make an Impact * Translate complex Treasury and Corporate Finance business requirements into robust IT solution designs, ensuring alignment with strategic business objectives* Coordinate business stakeholders, IT teams, architects and external partners to define requirements, challenge technical concepts and ensure seamless system integration* Lead complex IT projects from initiation to deployment, ensuring delivery within agreed timelines, budgets and quality standards* Manage project risks, issues and cross-functional dependencies, applying agile and traditional project management methodologies* Act as the primary interface between Treasury and Corporate Finance business units and central IT, ensuring transparent communication and effective stakeholder management* Build, retain and document critical Treasury and Corporate Finance IT knowledge, strengthening internal capabilities and reducing dependency on external consultantsWhat You Bring* A bachelor's or master's degree in Business Informatics, Computer Science, Business Administration with a finance or IT focus, or an equivalent qualification.* Extensive experience in IT Business Analysis and Project Management within Treasury and Corporate Finance, including complex IT transformation projects.* Strong knowledge of Treasury processes and systems, including payments, bank connectivity, FX, cash management, guarantees, insurance and credit risk, as well as Treasury Management Systems such as SAP Treasury or TRE4.0.* Solid understanding of enterprise IT landscapes, financial systems integration, solution architecture, interfaces and requirements engineering.* Proven experience in agile and traditional project management, including risk, issue, dependency and external partner management. PMP, PRINCE2, CSM, PSM or CTP certification is an advantage.* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to bridge business and technical teams. Fluent in English; German is an advantageAbout the TeamIn our Business Functions we enable our organization to reach their targets by providing best-in class services and solutions in the areas of IT, HR, Finance, Real Estate, Strategy & Technology and more. Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideoOur Commitment to Diversity Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. Rewards/Benefits * In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs

OVERVIEWWe are currently seeking a Specialist* to join our Mass Spectrometry team in Tuebingen, Germany. Your work will focus on high-end liquid chromatography–mass spectrometry (LC-MS) systems and the reliable analysis of samples for immunopeptidomics and proteomics, helping advance our platform toward future clinical applications and contributing to our mission of delivering novel PRAME immunotherapies to patients with cancer.Working closely with laboratory scientists and colleagues in Data Intelligence, you will help connect sample preparation, instrument operation and data evaluation through streamlined, digitally connected workflows. This is an opportunity to contribute your technical expertise and ideas, keep advanced analytical systems performing at their best and turn valuable samples into reliable, high-quality data.This position is offered on a fixed-term contract for 24 months.YOUR MISSIONYour main responsibilities will include but are not limited to the following tasks:- Coordinate sample receipt with laboratory scientists, prepare and load samples for LC-MS analysis, and organize measurement sequences to ensure an efficient, traceable workflow.- Independently operate high-end LC-MS systems, monitor data acquisition and perform routine instrument care, maintenance and troubleshooting in coordination with service engineers and technical support.- Perform and evaluate quality control and system suitability tests, monitor instrument performance and data quality, and investigate deviations to maintain reliable, reproducible measurements.- Plan, perform and evaluate experiments to establish, test and optimize LC-MS methods in collaboration with scientists; support instrument qualification and method validation.- Support initial data processing and review, and work with scientists and Data Intelligence colleagues to ensure the complete, well-documented transfer of data and sample information for downstream analysis.- Maintain complete, traceable records of samples, methods, results, deviations and instrument activities in accordance with SOPs and applicable quality requirements, and help improve digital documentation and laboratory workflows.YOUR PROFILEYou have completed training as a BTA, MTA/MTLA or CTA, or hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Chemistry, Biochemistry, Biotechnology or a related scientific field. Ideally, you bring industry experience in biotechnology or pharmaceuticals, particularly in analytical laboratory environments. Hands-on experience with HPLC/UHPLC and/or mass spectrometry, including instrument operation, maintenance and troubleshooting, is highly desirable.Experience with regulated laboratory processes, GCP-compliant documentation, SOPs, data integrity, sample traceability and electronic laboratory documentation is an advantage.You are passionate about optimizing laboratory workflows and have an interest in digital tools and AI-supported process improvements. You work in a structured, proactive and independent manner, while collaborating effectively across teams and adapting to changing priorities. Good written and spoken English is required; German language skills are a plus.WHY US?We are the global leader in precision targeting of PRAME. Driven by our mission to make an impact on the lives of patients with cancer, we are a committed and inspired team and cherish the collegial, highly motivated, and family-friendly atmosphere within Immatics. We offer an innovative and collaborative environment where employees are empowered to contribute to groundbreaking cancer therapies and further their professional growth. To support their well-being, we provide opportunities for continuous learning, a company-sponsored pension scheme, childcare support, and our flexible “Two Out of Three” benefits concept, which allows employees to receive subsidies for two of the following options: EGYM Wellpass, JobRad, and JobTicket.NOTICE*We value diversity and inclusion. Immatics N.V. and all Immatics subsidiaries are equal opportunity employers that evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sex, age, marital status, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or other characteristics protected by law.ABOUT IMMATICSImmatics is committed to making a meaningful impact on the lives of patients with cancer. We are the global leader in precision targeting of PRAME, a target expressed in more than 50 cancers. Our cutting-edge science and robust clinical pipeline form the broadest PRAME franchise with the most PRAME indications and modalities, spanning TCR T-cell therapies and TCR bispecifics.

jobs.description: IRC (International Rescue Committee) Germany is seeking aProgram Development & Award Advisor (d/f/m), Latin America- in Berlin, or remote (within Germany) | as soon as possible- in part-time (20 hours/week), increase to full-time in the future might be possible (contingent upon funding) | initially for 2 yearsAbout UsFounded in 1933 at the call of Albert Einstein, the IRC offers lifesaving care and life-changing assistance to refugees forced to flee from war or disaster. In 2016, IRC Germany was founded and engages in global humanitarian work as well as throughout Germany in the areas of education, economic wellbeing, and safety, legal protection, and empowerment.IRC’s Crisis Response, Recovery and Development Department (CRRD) runs humanitarian relief, recovery, and development programs focused on safety, health, education, economic well-being, and people’s power to influence decisions, with particular attention to women and girls. Its Awards Management Unit (AMU) secures and manages government donor funding, bridging donors and country programs while ensuring compliance and managing risk. In Latin America and the Caribbean, the IRC responds to crises in Colombia, Ecuador, Venezuela, Mexico, Central America, and Haiti, supporting displaced and host communities through local partners and direct implementation. The Program Development and Award Advisor (PDAA) provides pre- and post-award support to country offices, ensures donor and IRC compliance, leads donor deliverables, and manages donor relationships.Major Responsibilities- Strategic Business Development: support country offices in advancing strategic business development planning efforts, donor engagement, intelligence gathering, positioning and capture. Prepare for and participate in donor meetings, engagement calls, and strategic discussions as needed. - Proposal development: provide quality assurance and quality compliance support on proposals, leading proposal development and coordination as needed. Ensure responsiveness to and compliance with solicitation documents and with IRC’s requirements and policies. - Award portfolio management: manage a portfolio of awards and act as the first point of contact for country award staff on compliance issues. Review agreements and lead negotiation of award terms and conditions with donor counterparts. - Partnerships: guide country offices in managing local and international partners in line with IRC’s PEERs system, and review and process sub-grant agreements. - Monitoring: monitor projects to ensure progress against objectives and compliance with donor guidelines and IRC internal requirements. Monitoring awards can take the shape of monitoring visits, participation in routine meetings and other regular calls. - Experience writing, reviewing and editing funding proposals and other donor deliverables and excellent attention to detail.- Excellent written and oral communication skills, including experience in speaking on relevant issues with internal and external audiences.- English and Spanish language skills at C1-level according to the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CERF) (https://www.europaeischer-referenzrahmen.de/) . Additional knowledge of French and/or German highly desirable.- Solid organizational and creative problem-solving skills: ability to be flexible and work well under pressure in a fast-paced multi-tasking team environment- Excellent IT skills (Word, Outlook, Excel)- Ability and willingness to travel internationally (up to 15 %)- Reporting: provide timely support on narrative reporting, amendments, and modifications. Ensure timely submission of high-quality donor deliverables.- Donor liaison: manage donor relationships on contractual issues, compliance queries and approvals, and represent IRC externally at events and meetings.- Capacity building: mentor Grants and Partnerships staff, develop and deliver training, and support recruitment and onboarding of new team members.- Other duties: contribute to AMU and regional strategic priorities, work with communications teams on donor communication products, and maintain checklists and work processes and systems. Your Profile- Significant work experience in award management or business development with EU donors, particularly ECHO, and other public donors. Experience with and a strong understanding of institutional donors’ compliance requirements.- Two years of international field experience highly desirable, familiarity with countries in the region preferred.- Excellent interpersonal & communication skills: ability to successfully and effectively liaise with people within and across departments in a multi-cultural environment.- Good financial management and budgeting skills- Ability to analyze and synthesize information, work collaboratively as part of a diverse team, handle complex tasks, and work independently We Offer- Meaningful work within a collaborative team- A starting salary between 32.000 and 33.500 Euro gross per year (for part-time, 20 hours/week) as well as an annual salary increase- Attractive employee benefits such as gym membership, company pension scheme, shopping vouchers, childcare subsidy, job bike leasing, subsidized Deutschlandticket (national public transport), and access to timely and confidential psychological support if needed- 30 days of annual leave and special leave days- Flexible hybrid-work options (working hours, office/homebased)- Training and professional development opportunities, including access to free language courses- Assistance services for people with disabilities, if required.We look forward to receiving your application (including CV and – if available – three references) via our application portal (https://theirc.wd1.myworkdayjobs.com/de-DE/External_Careers/job/Berlin-Germany/Program-Development---Award-Advisor--d-f-m---Latin-America_JR00006189) – even if you do not meet all the listed requirements. For questions, please contact Friederike Haarbrücker (HR.Deutschland@rescue.org (https://mailto:HR.Deutschland@rescue.org) ).As an organization committed to an empowering work environment, equal opportunities, and against any form of discrimination, we welcome applications from people regardless of their origin, religion, gender, sexual orientation, disabilities, age, or other characteristics protected by applicable law. We particularly encourage people with personal or family experience of flight and migration to apply.With equal qualifications, we give preference to applications from people with severe disabilities. If you have any questions about accessible applications or inclusion, please feel free to contact our Inclusion Officer, Christine Mader (christine.mader@rescue.org (https://mailto:christine.mader@rescue.org) ).To ensure equal opportunities, we kindly ask you to refrain from including photos in your application documents.There is no specific application deadline for this job posting. The position needs to be filled as soon as possible and will remain posted until filled.All IRC workers must adhere to the core values and principles outlined in IRC Way - Standards for Professional Conduct (https://www.rescue.org/page/our-code-conduct) . On this basis, the IRC operates and enforces policies on Safeguarding (https://www.rescue.org/page/safeguarding) , Conflicts of Interest, Fiscal Integrity, and Anti-Retaliation.You can find more information about IRC Germany at IRCDeutschland.org (https://www.irc-deutschland.org/) .Homeoffice:Umfang: Nach Vereinbarung

About EASEEASE builds active, AI-powered exoskeletons for logistics and manufacturing. As a TUM spin-off, we have just started series production, and paid pilots with well-known logistics companies have led to first purchase orders. Our goal: move every parcel better, manually with an exoskeleton or autonomously with a robot.The roleWith the LU 20, our first active exoskeleton is going into series production and gaining its first experience with customers in logistics and manufacturing. Your job is to optimise the LU 20's mechanics with what we learn in the field and take the next generation to series readiness, so that heavy physical work becomes easier and healthier for the people in warehouses and production plants.What you'll do- Further develop the mechanics of the LU 20 while keeping the complete system in view- Turn customer deployments and tests on our endurance rigs into concrete improvements- Design new features in SolidWorks and validate them with strength analyses (FEA)- Take features from prototype to series, incl. DFM, manufacturing processes and CE testing- Integrate sensors and electronics into the mechanical design and shape human-machine interaction- Work closely with our electronics, embedded software and physical AI teamsWhat you bring- Degree in mechatronics, mechanical engineering or similar, with 1 to 3 years of experience in product development; graduates with relevant projects are welcome- Very good knowledge of mechanics and mechanical design in a CAD tool (e.g. SolidWorks, Creo or Siemens NX)- Understanding of design for manufacturing and strength verification (e.g. FEA, DFM or tolerance analysis)- Business-fluent German or English; both languages are a plus- The drive to take ownership of a product in series production and make a real impact as a teamNice to have- Experience in lightweight design and with electronics or microcontrollers; ideally you have taken a product through CE testing or to market- A background in ergonomics, biomechanics, sports science or physiotherapy, as our exoskeleton works directly on the human bodyDon't tick every box? Apply anyway. The GFZ Helmholtz Centre for Geosciences is one of the world's leading institutions in the field of geosciences. As part of the Helmholtz Association, Germany's largest research organisation, we address global challenges such as natural hazards, climate change and the sustainable use of resources. In doing so, we combine cutting-edge research with social relevance. Our international staff - around 1,200 employees and approx. 500 guests - work in a multidisciplinary way and with a unique infrastructure to research the dynamic processes of the Earth system. Our vision: "Taking the pulse of our Earth to safeguard a habitable planet."For section 2.1 "Physics of Earthquakes and Volcanoes" (https://www.gfz.de/en/section/physics-of-earthquakes-and-volcanoes/overview) (department “Geophysics (https://www.gfz.de/en/geophysics) ”), we are looking for a:Research scientist (f_m_x) - SeismologyReference Number 11691Earthquakes induced by human activities, such as deep geothermal energy production, can cause ground shaking that raises concerns among local communities. Understanding earthquake source processes and predicting the resulting ground motions, including their uncertainties, are important for assessing seismic impacts and supporting transparent communication with stakeholders.Within the BMWE-funded collaborative project "Seismological Analysis and Societal Relevance of Deep Energy Projects (SAURIER)", GFZ is responsible for the subproject "TRansparent Interpretation and Characterisation of Earthquake RAdiation Patterns through probabilistic moment TensOr inversion and PGV Simulations (TRICERATOPS)". We are looking for a motivated researcher with a strong background in seismology and experience in earthquake source analysis and seismic waveform processing.The successful candidate will contribute to developing and applying probabilistic methods for earthquake source characterisation and physics-based ground motion modelling. The research will focus on quantifying the influence of earthquake source parameters and subsurface structure on predicted ground motions and their uncertainties, with the aim of estimating seismic impact zones.Fraunhofer IEG coordinates SAURIER and brings together seismological and social science research to improve the assessment and communication of induced seismicity.Your responsibilities:- Analyse seismic waveform datasets and determine earthquake source parameters, particularly for small to moderate earthquakes, using probabilistic methods including uncertainty quantification- Integrate earthquake source parameters and their uncertainties into physics-based ground motion simulations using numerical modelling tools such as Pyrocko and its Green's function modelling framework- Investigate the sensitivity of predicted ground motions to source parameters, including focal mechanism, source depth and rupture characteristics, as well as subsurface structure- Develop and validate probabilistic ground motion models for moderate earthquakes and contribute to the estimation of seismic impact zones- Develop, test and document scientific software and reproducible analysis workflows- Develop clear and accessible visualisations of earthquake source characteristics, probabilistic ground motion simulations and estimated seismic impact zones for different target groups, including scientists, authorities and the general public, in collaboration with social science partners at UFZ- Collaborate with project partners and contribute to the interpretation and communication of scientific results- Publish research results in peer-reviewed scientific journals and present findings at national and international conferences- Contribute to project reports, meetings and scientific outreach activitiesAbout You:Essential Qualifications:- A Master's degree (MSc) and a PhD in Earth Science, with a focus on seismology and geophysics- Solid geophysical and seismological background- Experience in local earthquake analysis, including moment tensor inversion- Good programming skills in Python, experience in scientific data processing, and experience in developing, adapting and validating computational methods for seismological research, including the implementation of reproducible workflows in Python- Familiarity with seismology toolboxes (e.g. Pyrocko, ObsPy) and visualisation tools (e.g. GMT, ParaView, QGIS)- Experience in scientific research, demonstrated through a convincing and strong publication record, software contributions and other research outputs appropriate to career stage- Good written and spoken English and the ability to communicate scientific results clearly- Experience in collaborative and externally funded research projectsDesirable Qualifications:- Experience in numerical seismic wave propagation or ground motion modelling- Knowledge of probabilistic inversion methods, uncertainty quantification or sensitivity analysis- Experience with induced seismicity and analysis of moderate earthquakesStart date: 1st April 2027Fixed-term: 24 MonateSalary: Die Stelle ist nach TVöD Bund mit der Entgeltgruppe 13 bewertet. Die Eingruppierung erfolgt nach den tariflichen Bestimmungen und den entsprechenden persönlichen Voraussetzungen.Working hours: Teilzeit 50% (derzeit 19,50 h/Woche)Place of work: PotsdamWhat we offer:- Ambitious and varied tasks in a dynamic and international research environment- State-of-the-art equipment- Public service benefits- Extensive training opportunities- Professional career advice offered by our in-house Career-Centre- Flexible working hours and conditions- Support with finding a good work-life balance offered by benefit@work- Institute day-care centre on siteHave we piqued your interest?If so, we look forward to receiving your application by 9th December 2026. Please use our online application form only.Required documents: letter of motivation, CV, academic degree certificates/gradesThe GFZ actively promotes diversity and equal opportunities. jobs.description: Innomotics GmbHJobID: 6858Location: Erlangen, Schuhstr. 60Department: IN SYSO PPMMode of Employment:  Permanent / Full-timeWe are looking for a Product Portfolio Manager, focus High Power Electrical Drives (m/f/d) to join our team at Innomotics.The Industry-Leader of Motors and DrivesInnomotics is an industry-leading supplier of motors and large drive systems. With a trusted legacy of more than 150 years of engineering expertise, our products power all of the world's most essential industries. Today, we are bringing the #EnergyTransition to life with a portfolio that enables our customers to boost energy efficiency, reduce greenhouse gases, and minimize the carbon footprints of plants.Our Most Powerful Engine: Our PeopleWe are a team of more than 15,000 dedicated experts, doers, innovators. For us, engineering the future means keeping businesses in motion. As a global player operating with the spirit and speed of a mid-sized champion, the future holds unlimited opportunities for us. If you share our bold mindset to be best-in-class, we want you IN.As a Product Portfolio Manager, you understand well the high-power drives technology and are responsible for the strategic composition, management, and optimization of the responded portfolios. The primary task is to agree and profitably invest the allocated budgets for innovation (R&D, maintenance) while strictly adhering to stakeholder's portfolio necessities to achieve the business goals set in the Annual Operating Plan (AOP).Your Future Role- Investment Strategy: Define short-term (1 year) and mid-term (3 to 5 years) high-power drives portfolio investment plans to achieve the business goals set in the AOP.- Innovation: Manage the yearly R&D activities (including maintenance, design to cost, engineering optimization) according to the portfolio investment plan.- Budget: Agree and manage the yearly R&D budget across the responded high-power drives portfolio (e.g., STATCOM, grid to grid, ship to shore applications).- Market Analysis: Continuously monitor the relevant global markets and economic trends like energy transition, turbine replacement, power grid opimization.- Portfolio Rebalancing: Regularly adjust and reallocate innovation investments in response to relevant market changes.- Portfolio and Business Relations: Provide transparent R&D performance reporting and generate new high-power drives portfolio investment ideas to achieve the business goals set in the AOP.Your Profile- You hold a university degree in Electrical Engineering or Power Electronics or a combination of an electrical engineering technical bachelor's degree and a business-focused master's degree (such as an MBA).- You are familiar with high-power drives technology (medium voltage drives/systems, high voltage motors) and can represent it internally and externally.- You have already several years of professional experience with a technology provider, system integrator or consultancy company for high-power power electrical solutions or system design/engineering specialized in projects for energy transition, grid compliance, oil&gas or similar.- You quickly grasp macroeconomic relationships, build arguments and create a strategic plan.- You clearly and simply explain complex systems to stakeholders, fluently in English and German.What's IN it for you (Our Benefits)- Compensation according to the applicable collective agreements of the The position combines the strengths of a traditional Proposal Manager with the commercial responsibilities of a Commercial Project Manager, ensuring seamless end-to-end support and continuity for both the customer and the project team.In the proposal phase, the Proposal & Contract Manager is responsible for coordinating, developing and pricing competitive and sustainable offers. During project execution, the role takes ownership of the commercial aspects of the contract, ensuring that budgets, profitability targets and contractual commitments are successfully achieved.Acting as the commercial counterpart within the project, the Proposal & Contract Manager steers project-related commercial activities, safeguards adherence to budgetary guidelines and helps align customer expectations with Veridos' business objectives. The role contributes to successful project outcomes by balancing commercial performance, contractual compliance and customer satisfaction.To achieve this, the Proposal & Contract Manager works closely with a broad range of stakeholders across the organization, including Sales Managers, Project Managers, Service Level Managers, Commercial Order Managers and other key functions. Strong collaboration, communication and stakeholder management skills are therefore essential for success in this position.Your Responsibilities- Lead and coordinate complex proposal processes from opportunity shaping through bid submission and contract handover.- Analyze customer requirements and develop commercially and technically viable solution approaches in collaboration with Sales, Customer Solutions and Business Lines.- Own commercial bid calculations, pricing models and business case development to ensure competitive, profitable and executable proposals.- Drive bid qualification activities, including risk assessments, resource planning and bid/no-bid recommendations.- Coordinate cross-functional teams and stakeholders throughout the proposal lifecycle, ensuring quality, compliance and timely delivery.- Prepare and support management approval processes, including financial, cash flow and risk assessments.- Develop and maintain strong customer relationships during the bid and contract execution phases, acting as a trusted advisor on commercial and contractual matters.- Identify commercial risks and opportunities early and implement appropriate mitigation or optimization measures to support sustainable business growth.- Act as the commercial lead during the transition from bid phase to project execution, ensuring a seamless handover and contractual alignment.- Serve as the key contact for contractual and commercial matters throughout the project lifecycle.- Monitor commercial project performance, including budgets, profitability, receivables and risk mitigation measures.- Support contract negotiations, customer correspondence and commercial governance activities.- Drive continuous improvement through lessons learned, market insights and optimization of proposal and commercial management processes.- Foster collaboration across Sales, Customer Solutions, Business Lines, Project Management and other key stakeholders to ensure successful project delivery.Your Qualifications- Degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Project Management or a comparable qualification.
